official_contracts.contract: Delegate applies only to service/scope; manager owns unit attributes, delegate owns descendants. Do not hand-create under managed slices. Move process into a leaf before enabling domain controllers.
cgroup.procs moves own forked processes; descendants remain constrained by ancestor limits. No internal PIDs when distributing domain controllers; empty leaf directories may be removed.
RemainAfterExit keeps service logically active after all processes exit. Typeoneshot startup waits for command completion; bounded TimeoutStartSec is used here.
Normal invocation waits for start-job completion; --wait/--pipe wait for service termination and are deliberately not used with retained active(exited) service.
